about: Truro is a town in central Nova Scotia at the hub of the province’s highway and rail network, near the Salmon River and the Minas Basin’s tidal flats. Victorian architecture, Victoria Park’s gorge trails, and a role as “Hubtown” for the Maritimes define the community. About 13,000 people live in Truro.
seoSummary: Central Nova Scotia hub town near the Minas Basin—Victoria Park, Victorian streets, and provincial crossroads.
